body: CORRECTED DECK.GL ADAPTER PLAN AFTER EXACT BUILD AUDIT. The stable semantic scene is not StoryAtlas-owned: NarrativeScene, VisualPrimitive, and CodexFlow come from storymodel4s.view; StoryAtlas layout adds deterministic pagination, and the existing cross-built intaglio module lowers those provider artifacts into Intaglio scenes and SVG. Do not create a second neutral mark ontology. Add deck.gl, if admitted, as a separate optional Scala.js-only lowering module beside intaglio, consuming the same provider artifacts and PaginatedCodex where relevant. The current app directly calls SvgRenderer; the spike should first introduce the narrowest app render-result/backend seam needed to choose SVG/Intaglio or deck.gl without moving projection, identity, evidence, or selection semantics out of storymodel4s. Backend capabilities must be explicit: regions, routes and portals, terrain, text, picking, and tiles, with Unsupported or Failed dispositions and no silent blank. Admission court: render the same repeated-endpoint O3 fixture, feature terrain, and named high-mark-count scene through both lowerings; prove provider-coordinate preservation, mark/address/evidence identity, selection round trips, requested-layer and suppression accounting, keyboard/non-colour and textual equivalents, and local filesystem opening; then compare frame time, memory, and bundle size under a named environment. A deck.gl preview may vendor compiled assets and inline file-origin-safe data; network-independent packaging is a separately certified profile unless promoted by owner or Chief. Keep the adapter removable inside StoryAtlas. Extract a general library only after a second non-story consumer proves the abstraction. Chief: proposed scoped dependency/capability spike after the durable output contract and O3 fixture; exact module name and paths require your ADR line and bead.
